name: get_project_lead
description: Returns the real project lead's name and status for an exact project name
code:
def get_project_lead(project_name: str) -> str:
    from databricks.sdk.service.sql import StatementParameterListItem
    warehouse_id = next(w.warehouses.list()).id
    resp = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
        statement="SELECT lead_name, status FROM workspace.default.projects WHERE name = :project_name LIMIT 1",
        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
        parameters=[StatementParameterListItem(name="project_name", value=project_name)],
        wait_timeout="30s",
    )
    if resp.status and resp.status.state.value == "FAILED":
        return f"Could not look up project: {resp.status.error.message if resp.status.error else 'unknown error'}"
    rows = resp.result.data_array if resp.result else []
    if not rows:
        return f"No project found named '{project_name}'."
    lead_name, status = rows[0]
    return f"Project '{project_name}' is led by {lead_name} (status: {status})."

name: get_lead_workload
description: Given a project lead's exact name, returns how many projects they currently lead
code:
def get_lead_workload(lead_name: str) -> str:
    from databricks.sdk.service.sql import StatementParameterListItem
    warehouse_id = next(w.warehouses.list()).id
    resp = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
        statement="SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.default.projects WHERE lead_name = :lead_name",
        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
        parameters=[StatementParameterListItem(name="lead_name", value=lead_name)],
        wait_timeout="30s",
    )
    if resp.status and resp.status.state.value == "FAILED":
        return f"Could not look up workload: {resp.status.error.message if resp.status.error else 'unknown error'}"
    rows = resp.result.data_array if resp.result else []
    count = rows[0][0] if rows else 0
    return f"{lead_name} currently leads {count} project(s)."

def get_employee_details(employee_name: str) -> str:
    from databricks.sdk.service.sql import StatementParameterListItem
    warehouse_id = next(w.warehouses.list()).id
    resp = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
        statement='SELECT * FROM workspace.default.users WHERE full_name = :employee_name',
        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
        parameters=[StatementParameterListItem(name='employee_name', value=str(employee_name))],
        wait_timeout="30s",
    )
    failed = bool(resp.status and resp.status.state.value == "FAILED")
    rows = resp.result.data_array if (resp.result and not failed) else []

    return str(rows)

name: list_users_with_lead
description: Lists all users with their email and associated lead if it exists
code:
def list_users_with_lead() -> str:
    from databricks.sdk.service.sql import StatementParameterListItem
    warehouse_id = next(w.warehouses.list()).id
    resp = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
        statement='SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.id) as serial_no, u.full_name, u.email, p.lead_name FROM workspace.default.users u LEFT JOIN workspace.default.projects p ON u.id = p.lead_id',
        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
        parameters=[],
        wait_timeout="30s",
    )
    failed = bool(resp.status and resp.status.state.value == "FAILED")
    rows = resp.result.data_array if (resp.result and not failed) else []

    if not rows:
        discover_resp = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
            statement=(
                "SELECT DISTINCT table_name FROM workspace.information_schema.columns "
                "WHERE table_schema = 'default' AND lower(column_name) = lower('lead_name')"
            ),
            warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
            wait_timeout="30s",
        )
        for row in (discover_resp.result.data_array if discover_resp.result else []):
            candidate_table = f"workspace.default.{row[0]}"
            fallback_sql = ('SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.id) as serial_no, u.full_name, u.email, p.lead_name FROM workspace.default.users u LEFT JOIN workspace.default.projects p ON u.id = p.lead_id').replace('workspace.default.users', candidate_table)
            fb_resp = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
                statement=fallback_sql,
                warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
                parameters=[],
                wait_timeout="30s",
            )
            if fb_resp.result and fb_resp.result.data_array:
                rows = fb_resp.result.data_array
                break

    if not rows:
        return 'No matching data found in workspace.default.users or any other table with a similarly named column.'
    return str(rows)

name: get_leads_and_project_count
